headline: Australia wins toss and bats first in 2nd T20I against Bangladesh
summary: Bangladesh makes two changes to the playing XI as they look to bounce back from a four-wicket defeat in the series opener.
details: Australia captain Mitchell Marsh won the toss and elected to bat first in the second T20I against Bangladesh on Friday. The match is being held at the Bir Shrestha Shaheed Flight Lieutenant Matiur Rahman Cricket Stadium in Chattogram.
Bangladesh enters the game trailing 1-0 in the three-match series after a four-wicket loss in the first T20I on Wednesday.
The Bangladesh squad has made two changes to the lineup, with Nahid Rana and Nasum Ahmed replacing Shoriful Islam and Mahedi Hasan.
Australia made one change to their playing XI, bringing in Aaron Hardie in place of Xavier Bartlett.
Stand-in captain Tawhid Hridoy confirmed that regular T20I skipper Litton Das is still recovering from an injury and remains unavailable for the match.
caption:
Australia wins the toss and elects to bat first in the 2nd T20I! 🏏

Australia captain Mitchell Marsh won the toss and elected to bat first in the second T20I against Bangladesh on Friday. The match is being held at the Bir Shrestha Shaheed Flight Lieutenant Matiur Rahman Cricket Stadium in Chattogram.

Bangladesh enters the game trailing 1-0 in the three-match series after a four-wicket loss in the first T20I on Wednesday.

The Bangladesh squad has made two changes to the lineup, with Nahid Rana and Nasum Ahmed replacing Shoriful Islam and Mahedi Hasan.

Australia made one change to their playing XI, bringing in Aaron Hardie in place of Xavier Bartlett.

Stand-in captain Tawhid Hridoy confirmed that regular T20I skipper Litton Das is still recovering from an injury and remains unavailable for the match.

headline_marked: Gold and silver [[prices drop significantly]] in Bangladesh
headline: Gold and silver prices drop significantly in Bangladesh
summary: Both precious metals have seen a decrease in price per bhori, providing relief to buyers.
details: Gold and silver prices have experienced a significant decline in the local market of Bangladesh.
The drop in prices is reflected in the cost per bhori, making these precious metals more affordable for consumers.
According to market reports, the current selling prices for gold and silver have decreased compared to previous rates.
This price correction comes as a welcome change for those planning to purchase jewelry or invest in precious metals.
The market continues to fluctuate based on international trends and local demand.
caption:
Gold and silver prices are falling! Find out how much the cost per bhori has dropped.

Gold and silver prices have experienced a significant decline in the local market of Bangladesh.

The drop in prices is reflected in the cost per bhori, making these precious metals more affordable for consumers.

According to market reports, the current selling prices for gold and silver have decreased compared to previous rates.

This price correction comes as a welcome change for those planning to purchase jewelry or invest in precious metals.

The market continues to fluctuate based on international trends and local demand.
